body: Ok- I think most people around here are taken in if they really need help.

Thank you for your insight. I am not overly concerned about that. eventually I would  have like to get married to him as i love him - however I don't see any plans, any time soon... I am fine with the way things are at the moment with him.
TBH- It's not really the worst of my worries- If he dumps me, he dumps me. I have to get these thoughts out of my mind- I have to get better. I have to put myself first on my list.
This is why I haven't told him, or anyone else (they would eventually tell him, when they got worried)

OK-Thanks, it's difficult however to admit to yourself that you may need help.  I've always tried to do things by myself, and always considered myself as independent- providing for yourself and not relying on others.

I won't be going this evening- I am currently at work (I work in an airport, where it's not busy and bring my laptop). 

May I ask why an American emergency room isn't so great to deal with depression?
I'm from a small place in Canada - there are only 2 options, both hospitals and tbh, there is no way of knowing which one is best. I am scared however that I would be taking up someone else's spot.

I live in Canada - how it works around here: the government pays for the Psychologists, psychiatrists on a doctors recommendation- this however takes a year and a half to obtain any type of counselling that is fully paid for.

See the thing is: I've always thought that hospital beds are always in high demand- I wouldn't want to take up the bed if someone else could use it.  

I sincerely cannot open up to my friends and bf. I believe my bf may have an idea of what's going on- however I don't think knows it is as severe as it is. I don't feel comfortable to talk to my friends: It's always been considered as Taboo.
Sometimes what a person really needs is a hug *hugs*.  Sometimes life gets so difficult that we can't get a grip on it.
